summary: Join our Information Quality and Standardization Training Course to master essential techniques for improving data quality and standardization in your business
lede: Information quality and standardization help teams make records and reports accurate, consistent, and usable. For professionals responsible for organizational data, records, and reporting, the course covers setting standards and quality rules, using validation checks and data dictionaries, resolving duplicates, and aligning KPI definitions across teams.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for corporate professionals across different sectors who are responsible for ensuring information is accurate, consistent, and usable.
modules: Foundations of Information Quality and Standardization
Root Causes of Poor Information Quality
Defining Data Standards that People Will Actually Follow
Data Dictionaries and Metadata that Reduce Confusion
Quality Improvement Planning and Quick Wins
Communicating Information Quality to Leadership and Stakeholders
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of organizational processes and familiarity with data handling in their respective roles.
